1445-4871-6277-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

950-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fatestitcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
950-4613-6859.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

339-677-4927-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2645-3181-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5189-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-1986-3263-7530.description:
Cast the copy of Bind to Life from exile by paying five mana and unpreparing Vastlands Scavenger.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vastlands Scavenger, which enters prepared.
Resolve the copy of Bind to Life, milling seven cards and optionally putting a creature card from among them onto the battlefield.
Activate Titans' Nest five times by exiling five cards from your graveyard, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that can be cast as though it were any color but only on colored spells without X in their cost.
Repeat.

757-2348-5087-5663.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-2348-5087-5663.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Cayth to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

3967-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
3967-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

2921-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
2921-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

579-2366-5702-7730.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-2366-5702-7730.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

955-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1169-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2933-4013-5798-7296.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

222-527-6798-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6798-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3652-4053-4779-6989.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1283-1978-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1283-1978-3007.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Toymaker.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

4395-4831-5166.description:
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it, dealing damage to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

518-3368-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-3368-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

104-4716-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4716-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

1-392-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-392-5796-6282.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Repeat.

913-4222-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Signpost Scarecrow.
913-4222-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
913-4222-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2770-4050-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2770-4050-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-1778-2232-6134.notablePrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana value 0 must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.
1003-1778-2232-6134.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 0 from your hand by paying {0}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
When the Bird enters the battlefield under your control, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a nontoken creature with mana value 0 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

2054-2440-2534-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
2054-2440-2534-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Coercive Recruiter for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

3814-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
3814-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Argothian Elder
3814-5149-5200.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Argothian Elder.
Repeat.
3814-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1247-1902-5536.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Wirewood Channeler and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1902-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

719-1238-2351-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1987-3821-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-4823.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake.
When Timeless Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-4823.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

586-997-2146-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1462-2351-5750.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
1462-2351-5750.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Shoal Kraken triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

4535-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4535-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Human token.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

97-338-3197.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
97-338-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing the Beast token, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

282-1379-1558-3907.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
282-1379-1558-3907.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Underworld Hermit with haste.
When the Underworld Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Underworld Hermit token and the Squirrel tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1143-4050-4763-4972.notablePrerequisites: Diviner's Wand attached to Star Pupil.
1143-4050-4763-4972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Star Pupil, adding {W}.
Star Pupil and Koll trigger.
Resolve Star Pupil's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on target creature you contorl.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Star Pupil from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Star Pupil by paying {W}.
Star Pupil enters the battlefield, triggering Diviner's Wand, attaching the Equipment to Star Pupil.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

1636-2158-5251.notablePrerequisites: Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2158-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4936.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-4936.description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
The token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloakwood Swarmkeeper, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cloakwood Swarmkeeper.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
